description: Second (TAIL) instance in closed form (qou-x631, qou-ogrk, A2/FMP): ν_{n-1}=Cov_Planch(N_{n-1},ω₃)=(n-1)(n-4)(n³-11n²+32n-30)·C(2n-6,n-3)/(3·n!). Carriers of hook length n-1 are the n-1 one-cell-off-the-cross diagrams (single row (n), single column (1^n), two-corner (a,2,1^c)), each N_{n-1}=1 (verified n≤25). Closed form exact n≤40. Sign = sign of the cubic n³-11n²+32n-30 (single real root ρ≈7.078): ν_{n-1}<0 for n=5,6,7, =0 at n=4, >0 for n≥8. SHARPENS (TAIL) ν_v≥0 for v>n/2+O(1): the v=n-1 tail is EMPTY (T(n)=n) for n≤7, so the +O(1) offset is nontrivial. Second derived TAIL instance after ν_n. Does NOT prove (TAIL)/FMP/A2/kernel. scope-(a); no fit wired; nothing wired; no c_k; L2 2/7.
